title: projects.json
description: The registry of the docs site: the projects whose docs/ folder is published, each one a git submodule at projects/<path>/. The build validates the same rules and says which entry is wrong; this schema is for the editor.

domain.description: The host name the site is served from, without a scheme.

name.description: The name of the whole site: the landing page and the 404 page.

org.description: The organization on GitHub: the footer and the header of pages that belong to no project.

projects.description: Sorted by path, so that a change shows as one line.

path.description: The URL segment and the submodule folder projects/<path>. A configuration value, never derived from the repository name. Not one of assets, brand, components, data, fonts, images, public, 404.

slug.description: The key of the project in the avunu.net catalog (it may hold underscores).

repo.description: https://github.com/<owner>/<repository>: Edit this page, the header link, repository links in the Markdown.

branch.description: The default branch of the repository: edit links name it, and a project without a release follows it.

docs.description: The Markdown folder inside the repository. Default docs.

local.description: The project lives in this repository (its documentation is the workspace's own), not in a submodule.
